name: CropCore — AI Agricultural Intelligence Platform
description: CropCore is an AI-powered smart farming assistant using ML and computer vision for crop monitoring, weed detection, disease diagnosis, and yield prediction with IoT sensor integration for real-time irrigation optimization. It equips farmers with technology by offering real-time sensor data (temperature, humidity, moisture, NPK), live market price tracking, AI-powered weed detection (YOLOv8), advanced disease detection (CNN), automated smart irrigation, and a community platform. The solution is designed to boost agricultural productivity and profitability by making modern technology accessible to farmers. The system has been patented under the Indian Patent Office (Application No: 202541067987).

name: CareerTrack — AI Career Intelligence Platform
description: CareerTrack is an AI-powered career platform developed as an Initial Validation Prototype (IVP) to help students and early professionals succeed in today's competitive job market. The platform bridges the gap between academic learning and industry readiness by offering an all-in-one career assistant — mock interview analysis, ATS-optimized resumes, AI-curated portfolios, mental wellness tools, and seamless web & mobile sync.
achievements: Initial Validation Prototype (IVP) — Live Demo Available

name: PKStruct — Production-Grade DSA Python Package
description: PKStruct is a production-grade Python package for optimized data structures, algorithms, visualization, and systems utilities. Built for scalability, education, competitive programming, and production use with modular, extensible, benchmarked, and PyPI-ready implementations. Features include linked lists, trees (BST, AVL, Red-Black, Segment, Fenwick, Interval), graphs (Dijkstra, Kruskal, Tarjan), thread-safe structures, strict type hints, 899+ tests, ASCII visualization, and a runtime help system. Published on PyPI with 20+ data structures and 35+ algorithms.
achievements: Thread-safe structures with strict type hints

name: KRED — AI-powered Financial Intelligence Platform
description: KRED is an AI-powered financial intelligence platform that analyzes user behavior and projects long-term financial outcomes through behavioral insights, life simulations, retirement planning, and an AI financial assistant, helping users make smarter financial decisions by visualizing future financial scenarios and personalized recommendations.
achievements: 1st Place — FinTech Track, Vashisht Hackathon 3.0 (IIITDM Kancheepuram)

name: AutCore — AI-driven Autism Screening Tool
description: AutCore is an AI-driven autism screening and risk assessment tool. The solution combines advanced oculomotor & facial behavior analysis, AI-powered speech & language disfluency analysis, intelligent autism symptom profiling & risk evaluation, and a conversational autism assistant. The team joined the hackathon 12 hours late, building the solution in just 24 hours under intense pressure.
achievements: 1st Place — HackHub'25 (IEEE CompSoc VIT-C, GitHub & Devfolio)
